content.transcript: Is Oceana becoming the watch every stylish woman is quietly wearing? Because if you look closely, the same women with the best taste all wear it. Hailey Bieber, Victoria Beckham, Sophia Ritchie. Not because they need another watch, but because it fits their image. Oceana just won a Vogue Design Award and has been sold out nine separate times. That doesn't happen because of what's inside the watch. Oceana isn't winning with mechanics, it's winning with who wears it. People buy it because it looks like quiet luxury. Because when women like Hailey, Victoria and Sophia wear something, it becomes the uniform of modern elegance. I think Oceana proves one thing very clearly. Style beats specification. Deep down, everyone knows these watches aren't built to impress collectors. They're built to impress people. And that's exactly why Oceana keeps selling out.
